questions.stem: Which of the following statements about surgical margin during excision of melanoma is true ?

options.label: A
options.text: If depth of invasion is <1 mm surgical margin required is 0.5 cm

options.label: B
options.text: If depth of invasion is 2 mm surgical margin required is 3 cm

options.label: C
options.text: If depth of invasion is between 1 to 2 mm surgical margin required is 1-2 cm

options.label: D
options.text: If there is melanoma in situ no surgical margin is to be excised
